banner.title: The OA promotion batch five - rounds R695 through R712 complete - the 160-round set continues
banner.provenance: The OA promotion arc round five, the fifth rules promotion batch from the pin headers themselves (the promotion-from-headers doctrine, R981): eighteen records promoted mechanically from rules/oa{round}.h into content/rules/oa/ - rounds R695 through R712 complete (the learning of martial arts, the OA calendar, the Table 71-73 yearly, monthly and daily event tables with their explanation rounds, the Chapter 11 terrain encounter tables, the climate groupings, and the bestiary opener set - the Bajang, Bakemono, Bisan, Buso, Giant Carp, Con-Tinh, Doc Cu'o'c and the Oriental Dragons), 825 model items (consts, bools, switches, chains), every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof), the audit conditions converted to bad-detector examples and the local-array audits left behind the C++ pins. This batch is 299242 bytes of Lua. Cumulative ninety-nine of the 160-round OA set, 61 rounds remaining.
